notablePrerequisites: Cloudblazer is paired with Deadeye Navigator.
description:
Activate Cloudblazer by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Cloudblazer enters the battlefield, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger.
Resolve the Cloudblazer trigger, causing you to draw two cards and gain 2 life.
The Locust God triggers twice, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens with flying and haste.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Cloudblazer.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing the Insects, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.
